title: Reading the next table cell
statement: For Boolean lists $l$ and $r$ and a bit $b$, the buffer tape storing the concatenation of $l$, $b$, and $r$ contains $b$ at integer position $|l|$.
replaced:
For all bit strings $l$ and $r$ and every bit $b$, the buffer tape of the
concatenation of $l$, the single bit $b$, and $r$ reads the symbol $b$ at
position $|l|$.
